## In detail

### GAP-01 — IPR / patent portfolio management  ·  CRITICAL  ·  `SURVIVES, NARROWED`

- **Phase 0 claimed.** Zero of 11 competitors have an IPR module.
- **Falsified by.** Wellspring for Tech Transfer, Helikon Labs, Commercify and SINT.OTRI all implement invention disclosure, patent status/deadline, licensing and spin-out workflow. Four dedicated tech-transfer platforms exist.
- **What survives.** Dedicated IP/tech-transfer platforms EXIST but are not JOINED TO INCUBATION PROGRAMME MANAGEMENT, and none has Indian data residency. Incu (Sweden) has a patent field but not a workflow.
- **Nearest competitor.** Wellspring, Helikon Labs, Commercify, SINT.OTRI (TTO side); Incu (Sweden, field)
- **Why it matters in India.** ARIIA demands 'Patent Application No'; IIC registers IPR/TTO Centre by floor area with no patent field; MeitY mandates IP due diligence; HEI filings +119% in two years
- **Holders.** 0 of 28

### GAP-02 — TRL as a first-class, reportable object  ·  CRITICAL  ·  `SURVIVES UNCHANGED`

- **Phase 0 claimed.** Every platform tracks 'stage' as free text. Nobody models TRL.
- **Falsified by.** None found. Incu (Sweden) has maturity levels but no funding-scheme mapping.
- **What survives.** Every platform tracks 'stage' as free text. Nobody models TRL AND maps it to eligible Indian funding schemes.
- **Nearest competitor.** Incu (Sweden) - maturity levels only
- **Why it matters in India.** YUKTI-NIR bands on TRL 1–9; ARIIA asks for 'Stage of Innovation (TRL Stage)'; BIRAC/NIDHI/TIDE tranches tied to TRL progression
- **Holders.** 0 of 28

### GAP-03 — YUKTI-NIR / IIC / ARIIA submission workflow  ·  CRITICAL  ·  `SURVIVES UNCHANGED`

- **Phase 0 claimed.** Highest-value, most-defensible feature in the category - and completely open.
- **Falsified by.** None. No competitor, Indian or global, targets Indian government mandates.
- **What survives.** Zero of 29 competitors. Highest-value and most-defensible gap in the category.
- **Nearest competitor.** None. Zero of 29.
- **Why it matters in India.** Government mandate across three separate systems; verified YUKTI-NIR entries improve ARIIA ranking
- **Holders.** 0 of 28

### GAP-04 — Unified mandate-spanning reporting  ·  HIGH  ·  `SURVIVES, WEAKENED`

- **Phase 0 claimed.** Nobody reports the whole institutional innovation portfolio at once.
- **Falsified by.** Accubate Enterprise multi-site is genuinely the closest structure.
- **What survives.** Accubate has multi-site structure but no Indian mandate spans.
- **Nearest competitor.** Accubate (Enterprise)
- **Why it matters in India.** One institution files to ARIIA, NIRF, IIC, AICTE/NBA/NAAC, DST/NIDHI/BIRAC/TIDE, CSR, AIC, Governing Body, DPIIT
- **Holders.** 1 of 28

### GAP-05 — Government-grant disbursement ledger traced to a receipt  ·  HIGH  ·  `SURVIVES, STRENGTHENED`

- **Phase 0 claimed.** Cover with scheme-matching, not a general ledger.
- **Falsified by.** VentureLink adds grants/competitions tracked per team, raising holders to 4.
- **What survives.** Everyone has a general ledger; nobody scheme-matches to Indian eligibility.
- **Nearest competitor.** EcoSync, VentureLink, NestLens Orbit, AcceleratorApp
- **Why it matters in India.** BIRAC 5% royalty until cumulative repayment; unspent balance reversion is an audit failure
- **Holders.** 4 of 28

### GAP-06 — Faculty, Innovation Ambassadors and the non-startup innovator  ·  HIGH  ·  `SURVIVES, NARROWED`

- **Phase 0 claimed.** Completely unoccupied, and upstream of the whole funnel.
- **Falsified by.** Wellspring, Helikon Labs and Commercify all centre the FACULTY/researcher as the primary entity - the opposite of StartupHub's startup-first model.
- **What survives.** Faculty are first-class in TECH-TRANSFER platforms but absent from every INCUBATION platform, which all build from 'startup application'.
- **Nearest competitor.** Wellspring, Helikon Labs (faculty entity, no incubation)
- **Why it matters in India.** MIC trained 60,000+ faculty as Innovation Ambassadors; NIDHI-PRAYAS requires an institutional NOC from employed applicants
- **Holders.** 3 of 28

### GAP-07 — Mentor logistics at scale - NDA-tiered visibility  ·  HIGH  ·  `SURVIVES, WEAKENED`

- **Phase 0 claimed.** A real institutional fear that nobody has solved.
- **Falsified by.** MAARG (Startup India) does AI mentor matching at national scale, though without NDA tiers.
- **What survives.** MAARG matches mentors but does not tier visibility by NDA and does not log hours against scheme utilisation. The NDA gap itself survives.
- **Nearest competitor.** MAARG (government), incuTrack ($30/mo add-on)
- **Why it matters in India.** A single NDA leakage could void an IPR claim; AICTE YUKTI-NIR has NDA templates
- **Holders.** 1 of 28

### GAP-08 — AI that is auditable instead of just advertised  ·  MEDIUM  ·  `SURVIVES, WEAKENED`

- **Phase 0 claimed.** Nothing in the category offers defensible AI.
- **Falsified by.** FIKR (10-pillar AI pitch scoring), Dealum (AI assistant credits), IdeaScale (AI assistance), VentureLink (audit log on every score change), IncubatX, EcoSync.
- **What survives.** AI is now widespread, but audit trails are the differentiator: VentureLink logs every score change with actor and reason, and EcoSync refuses AI scoring outright.
- **Nearest competitor.** VentureLink (score-change audit log), EcoSync (counter-position on AI scoring)
- **Why it matters in India.** AI that cannot produce a citation trail is worse than no AI for an auditable committee process
- **Holders.** 5 of 28

### GAP-09 — Unincorporated pre-incubation state  ·  MEDIUM  ·  `SURVIVES UNCHANGED`

- **Phase 0 claimed.** The biggest structural hole in every platform.
- **Falsified by.** None found. Every platform assumes a registered entity.
- **What survives.** Every platform assumes a registered entity; the university funnel is mostly before incorporation.
- **Nearest competitor.** Incubatee - one line item on the pricing table
- **Why it matters in India.** DPIIT recognition, GST and Udyam gate every scheme; SIH had 139,844 teams registered
- **Holders.** 0 of 28

### GAP-10 — Guaranteed migration off forms/spreadsheets/WhatsApp  ·  MEDIUM  ·  `SURVIVES, WEAKENED`

- **Phase 0 claimed.** Incu (Sweden) only.
- **Falsified by.** VentureLink (data import in onboarding), Helikon Labs (start free), Phosphor-free onboarding in others.
- **What survives.** Still the #1 real blocker in an Indian institutional sale; more vendors claim it than actually do it.
- **Nearest competitor.** Incu (Sweden), VentureLink, Helikon Labs
- **Why it matters in India.** Migration is manual, unpaid work the BUYER must do
- **Holders.** 2 of 28

### GAP-11 — Departments and multi-campus sub-tenancy  ·  MEDIUM  ·  `SURVIVES, WEAKENED`

- **Phase 0 claimed.** Accubate Enterprise genuinely the closest.
- **Falsified by.** IdeaScale, Wazoku, Helikon Labs, ESH and Elsevier Pure all now claim multi-site or departmental structure.
- **What survives.** Multi-site is becoming table stakes; sub-tenant-per-DEPARTMENT with departmental P&L and SPV-vs-department IP ownership is still absent.
- **Nearest competitor.** Accubate, IdeaScale, Helikon Labs, ESH
- **Why it matters in India.** Departments each hold their own IIC coordinator, budget and mentor panel
- **Holders.** 4 of 28

### GAP-12 — Deployment model an Indian university can actually buy  ·  MEDIUM  ·  `SURVIVES, STRENGTHENED`

- **Phase 0 claimed.** Nobody packages on-premise/Indian data residency at an affordable price.
- **Falsified by.** None. EcoSync is INR-native but cloud; VentureLink is Canada-resident; Catalyzer is certified but US.
- **What survives.** Still unoccupied. Note Phase 8: Fedena sells a FULL ERP at ₹1,00,000 flat, so the market exists - StartupHub must simply match that shape.
- **Nearest competitor.** EcoSync (INR-native, cloud), Wazoku (unlimited users, but $15k/admin)
- **Why it matters in India.** Only Incubatee, IncubatX and Orbit publish an India price list
- **Holders.** 3 of 28

### GAP-13 — A verifiable Indian reference institution  ·  MEDIUM  ·  `SURVIVES, NARROWED`

- **Phase 0 claimed.** No competitor can prove a large Indian institution runs on their software.
- **Falsified by.** EcoSync names TBI-KIET (KIET Group of Institutions); Accubate names NSRCOM and NASSCOM; VentureLink publishes a NAMED_REFERENCE from ICUBE at the University of Toronto, which is a university incubator but NOT Indian.
- **What survives.** No competitor demonstrates a LARGE INDIAN UNIVERSITY deployment with named referees and third-party verification. The best evidence in the category is a VENDOR_CLAIM (EcoSync) and a NAMED_REFERENCE at a non-Indian university.
- **Nearest competitor.** EcoSync (TBI-KIET, vendor-claimed); VentureLink (ICUBE Toronto, named reference)
- **Why it matters in India.** Named Indian university case study with referees is still worth more than any feature
- **Holders.** 3 of 28
